name: ATK live-pair reward pricing
summary: The ATK reward contract sized claimToken1 from the configured pair's live ATK and USDT balances, so a claim inside a pair callback released reward inventory at a transient reserve ratio and the resulting ATK removed USDT from the pair.

loss.notes: Across the bounded nonce-5-through-18 campaign, the ATK/USDT pair sends 130,938.042674581496920399 + 127,677.363775463262166716 + 3,735.200016119348067113 USDT. It receives 134.728431544645009270 and 121.217699044304557015 USDT in the two linked ATK buys, then 131,271.934683401679737546 and 3,744.724776160452404684 USDT in the two flash repayments. The exact net depletion is 127,078.000876013025445713 USDT. Nonce 18 only moves the first helper's remaining 490.475239958895662429 USDT to the campaign EOA and leaves that helper at zero USDT; nonce 19 similarly withdraws the second helper's 166.107991179817182853-USDT remainder. Nonces 19-21 are downstream disposal, not victim flows. The unrelated source-4 swap in the claim block sends 61.384706202020868948 USDT out of the pair and 607.789 ATK in; excluding it reconciles archive balances. The two positions deposit 970.4654 and 971.1491 genuinely purchased ATK. The claim sends 51,066,033.07817472 ATK from the reward contract; the sale routes 46,038,567.993335287573138174 ATK back to the pair and 505,918.329597091072232287 ATK back to the reward contract. This endogenous reward inventory is not independent scarce consideration; its genuine acquisition costs are already netted in USDT.

ageReset.description: The direct reward contract constructor bound ATK, USDT and the live ATK/USDT pair. Its runtime was absent one block earlier, is unchanged before the claim, and no later token, USDT, pair, market or ownership setter executed before the incident.

sources.note: Reviewed the nonce-5-through-21 EOA scope, receipts and call traces; every ATK and USDT transfer touching the pair, reward contract and two helpers; archive balances around both buys, both flash callbacks, the final sale and helper withdrawals; the unrelated same-block swap; and the reward contract's deployment, constructor arguments, runtime and full pre-incident transaction history. The nonce-15 trace calls claimToken1 on 0x96bf during the pair callback. That runtime reads ATK and USDT balanceOf for pair 0xd228 while only 2.618813229756225063 USDT remains, then transfers 50,591,735.5573248 ATK to the helper and 474,297.52084992 ATK to 0x94cb. The first helper's nonce-17 callback produces no ATK payout, repays 3,744.724776160452404684 USDT after receiving 3,735.200016119348067113, and nonce 18 withdraws only its 490.475239958895662429-USDT funding remainder. The pair and both helpers' archive balances reconcile all declared amounts; source-4 accounts for the sole same-block pair mismatch. Source-5 directly creates 0x96bf at block 22,003,759 index 50. Its constructor arguments are ATK 0x9cb9, USDT 0x55d3, pair 0xd228, market 0x71d5 and 0x94cb. The 16,648-byte runtime is absent at block 22,003,758 and hashes to 0xf1db2538920f8ae7385df5977ffdc11c930e2b44b4d0901773e92486e7ac3f00 at creation, pre-claim and current state. Across all 801 successful and failed calls from creation through the pre-claim block, none invokes setToken, setUsdt, setPair, setMarket, transferOwnership or renounceOwnership. Deployment therefore remains the latest causal activation.
